verdict.detail: The album first came out in 1980 (UK).

notes.text:
, which has a different catalog number (EMC 3330) and publisher (Sanctuary Music) on the labels.

[On back cover]:
Recorded at Kingsway Studios, London
Mixed at Morgan Studios, London
℗ 1980 Original sound recording made by E.M.I. Records Ltd.
Distributed by EMI Records Hayes Middx

[On labels]:
Manufactured in the UK by EMI Records Limited

On some copies of the generic inner sleeve it states, "DRG Packaging Bags, British Patent No. 1125555, 321, 6/85, MADE IN GREAT BRITAIN".
On other copies of the generic inner sleeve it states, "Envelope Made In Western Germany and 321 - LFN 05/85".

Durations do not appear on this release.
All matrices are stamped.

Compared with the CD edition, if you keep the needle on the record after the initial ending of track A4 for about 30-45 seconds, you will hear Paul Di'Anno state an additional line from that track in a locked groove.
